description: Rules from the Cannabis Act and Cannabis Regulations that apply to every product sold in Canada. The checks are implemented in tools/validate.mjs (checkCanadaFederal, checkLotCanada); this file declares the profile and its sources.

sources.title: Cannabis Act, S.C. 2018, c. 16, Schedules 3 and 4
Cannabis Regulations, SOR/2018-144, ss. 89-102.7 and 123-132.19 (consolidated to 2026-09-30, incl. SOR/2025-43)
Proposed Order Amending the Cannabis Tracking System Order (Streamlining of Requirements), Canada Gazette Part I, Vol. 160, No. 39
